items.title: A surjective map onto a sober space along which specializations lift does not decrease dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the dimension comparison for a surjective map onto a sober space along which specializations (or generalizations) lift (author lemma at source lines 3982-3988, label lemma-dimension-specializations-lift). The proof (source lines 3990-4012) carries content in the lifting step: from a chain of irreducible closed subsets of the target the author lifts the generic point of the largest member and then climbs down the chain using the lifting hypothesis to obtain points whose closures form a chain of the same length in the source (proof lines 3991-4010). Sobriety of the target is what makes the generic points available in the first place. H2.
